title: Coincident-k hard criterion: band-path points on the mesh must equal the mesh values
symptom: A band-path stage is suspected wrong, but Gamma agrees and the discussion stalls.
root_cause: No cheap end-to-end invariant was being applied between the uniform-mesh QP stage and the band-path projection stage.
minimal_fix: For every band-path k that coincides with a screening-mesh k, compare EXX and GW state by state against the mesh-stage values; any deviation beyond output precision localizes the bug to the band/projection stage (this criterion is what exposed the BvK collapse bug).
validation: Documented pass: after the per-k fix, coincident GW states matched to 5.94 meV; EXX endpoints regained |Eexx| ~ 59.2 eV instead of 0.
avoid: Using only the Gamma point, or a handful of low states, as the cross-stage check.

parameters.check: path k on mesh must equal mesh EXX/GW
